name: mighty-reviewer
description: opencode plugin (OpenCode 1.18.29+ and 2.x) that runs an automatic background adversarial code review (mechanical gates + risk critique + DRY/SOLID/design enforcement + OWASP security checklist + AI-slop critique of code and prose) whenever a turn writes code, with a SHIP / NO-SHIP verdict.

scripts.hooks: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo hooks installed

author: Mightybeast12
